g.text: the price of each (Sec. 13.1.1): common-bus needs a comb / pre-multiplexed laser; Mod-Mux needs N lasers + N Mods + N filters, all wavelength-matched

g.text: Takeaway: same 40 Gb/s per channel at 32 fJ/bit, so the choice is about strengths — common-bus for flexibility and fewest parts,

g.text: and it can be particularly advantageous in minimizing tuning power; Mod-Mux to avoid cross-modulation and skip the comb.
